findings.evidence: grep: `DIS/Kinematics/Basic.lean:56-57` `noncomputable def xBj (g : Bilin V) (K : DisKinematics V) : ℝ := K.Q2 g / (2 * g K.p K.q)`; `DIS/Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:59,64,68` define `Q2`, `delta`, `tMom`. The new file's only import is `DIS.Kinematics.Basic` (line 8) yet its body references no declaration from it — it compiles because that module is `public import Mathlib`. The roadmap lists `Exclusive.Kinematics.Basic` as a Layer 0 dependency precisely as the `t`-carrying kinematics "which diffraction reuses rather than re-deriving" (Diffraction/README.md:176-179, 348-350), and Convention 1 (README.md:107-111) exists to prevent two unlinked momentum fractions sharing the name `x`.
findings.fix: Add the bridge rather than a second vocabulary: `def Invariants.ofExcl (g : Bilin V) (K : ExclKinematics V) (hPq : 0 < g K.p K.q) (hDq : 0 < -g K.delta K.q) (hQ2 : 0 < K.Q2 g) (ht : K.tMom g ≤ 0) : Invariants := ⟨g K.p K.q, -g K.delta K.q, K.Q2 g, K.tMom g, …⟩` (sign: `ExclKinematics.delta = pPrime - p` at line 64-65, while the roadmap's `Δ = P - P'`, and `t = Δ²` is sign-invariant so `t := K.tMom g` is correct), plus a `rfl`-level lemma `(Invariants.ofExcl g K …).x = K.Q2 g / (2 * g K.p K.q)` identifying it with `DisKinematics.xBj` on the `DisKinematics` built from `K.p, K.pPrime, K.k, K.kPrime, K.q, K.hqLepton`.
findings.issue: `Invariants.x i = i.Q2 / (2 * i.Pq)` restates `DisKinematics.xBj g K = K.Q2 g / (2 * g K.p K.q)` (DIS/Kinematics/Basic.lean:56-57) on a new carrier, and the `Q2`/`t`/`Dq` fields restate `ExclKinematics.Q2`, `.tMom`, `.delta` (DIS/Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:59-69). Nothing ties the two: there are now two definitions of the same Bjorken variable in the `DIS` namespace with no lemma relating them, so no diffractive result can be applied to a momentum-level event and no inclusive lemma (e.g. `Kinematics.Bounds.xBj_le_one`) transfers.

summary: The diffractive invariants re-derive the Bjorken variable and the off-forward scalar products that DisKinematics.xBj and ExclKinematics (Q2/tMom/delta) already provide, with no bridge between them; the module imports DIS.Kinematics.Basic and uses nothing from it. Everything else in the PR is genuinely new material.
